feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 August 2026 4:28pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 12 August 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly East or Southeast 3 or 4 this evening, but Variable 2 or 3 in places, then becoming South or Southwest 2 to 4 tonight. Little change tomorrow morning and afternoon, although again becoming Variable 2 or 3 in places.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then risk of mist and fog patches in the south of the area tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches the south of the area tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 2 to 4, veering West or Northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Friday, increasing 4 occasionally 5 on Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Risk of mist and fog patches patches at first and rain for a time, then becoming fair later in night or at first on Friday morning.


##Visibility##

Possibly poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches at first, otherwise good.
